snippet.title: Full Cinematic Trailer - FPS Gaming Has A New 80s Friend
snippet.description:
Ever wondered what happens when you mix the 80s with raw FPS gaming?
It's as chaotic and fun as you can imagine. You're welcome.

► Wishlist ASCENDANT on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803110

ASCENDANT is a squad-based tactical FPS with serious balls. Each match is different, with game-changing events and adrenaline-fueled battles. Set in a dynamic BioPunk world where everything wants to kill you; fight to extract resources, and get out with more than just your dignity.
